summary: On a live browser (HARNESS_MODE=real|stack; Verify Nightly runs stack) a device put on an outdated app build still spoke the current sync protocol: the build was applied only to in-process clients' server HTTP, while a browser device's page sends its own requests, in stack mode straight to the separately booted API. The server never answered upgrade_required, so 'Alice is asked to update the app within 15 seconds' timed out. The browser composition root now puts each device's page on its build: on launch, on every harness navigation and whenever the build changes.
